events.summary:
SVRLUB

The National Weather Service in Lubbock Texas has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Floyd County in northwestern Texas...
Northwestern Motley County in northwestern Texas...
Southwestern Hall County in the Panhandle of Texas...
Southeastern Briscoe County in the Panhandle of Texas...

* Until 500 PM CDT.

* At 415 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 5 miles east of
South Plains, or 16 miles northeast of Floydada, moving northeast
at 10 mph.

HAZARD...70 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect considerable
tree damage. Wind damage is also likely to mobile homes,
roofs, and outbuildings.

* Locations impacted include...
Turkey, Caprock Canyon State Park, Quitaque, Valley Schools,
Flomot, and South Plains.

events.summary:
...The National Weather Service in Omaha/Valley has issued a Flood
Warning for the following rivers in Iowa...

East Nishnabotna River At Red Oak affecting Montgomery County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...East Nishnabotna River at Red Oak.

* WHEN...Until late Wednesday night.

* IMPACTS...At 20.0 feet, Lowland flooding begins along the west
bank.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 4:00 PM CDT Tuesday the stage was 17.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 18.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
this afternoon to a crest of 19.7 feet just after midnight
tonight. It will then fall below flood stage by late tomorrow
morning.
- Flood stage is 18.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 19.6
feet on 06/15/1980.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
